Run `node ./.next/standalone/server.js` to run the standalone server. It is expected that the server listening on `0.0.0.0` on network. ``` ▲ Next.js 15.4.0-canary.34 - Local: http://localhost:3000 - Network: http://0.0.0.0:3000 ``` 5.
